label: H.R. 4382
title: America’s Olympic and Paralympic Games Commemorative Coins Act
short_title: America’s Olympic and Paralympic Games Commemorative Coins Act

latest_action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Financial Services.

summary: America’s Olympic and Paralympic Games Commemorative Coins Act This bill requires the Department of the Treasury to mint and issue coins in commemoration of the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games to be held in Los Angeles, California; and the 2034 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games to be held in Salt Lake City, Utah. Treasury must promptly pay the surcharges collected from the sale of the coins to the Olympic organizations designated by the bill for purposes related to the hosting of the games and to aid in the execution of legacy programs.
summary_short: Requires the Department of the Treasury to mint and issue coins in commemoration of the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games to be held in Los Angeles, California.
current_title: America’s Olympic and Paralympic Games Commemorative Coins Act
